SPECS. Specs/README.md: ID grammar is REQ-<DOMAIN>-<sec>.<n>. IDs are permanent. Withdrawn IDs stay in the body as stub bullets ("stricken" or "*(Withdrawn <date> ...)*") AND appear in the doc's Withdrawn table. This is by design, not a defect. Waived and Unenforceable tables list active IDs (each needs Dan's approval date). Specs never name source files, functions or tests. Linkage is only by test names beginning with REQ IDs. Source and migrations carry NO REQ annotations (retired 2026-07-31, settled). The traceability gate (Checks/check-traceability.sh -> Skills/SonOfLeoRequirementsAudit/traceability-audit.sh) runs on main only. BdsNotes/ is excluded and keeps the old FT- prefix. Authority: Specs/Behavioral > everything else. History dirs (Specs/Archive, Audit, HobsonsNotes, BdsNotes) are never authority. Specs/Definitions.md (78 lines) defines: The system, Money, Price, Quantity, Rate, Entity (litmus: does any user action insert/update a row), Instant, Date, Calendar period, Pre-ledger date (2026-10-10; before the earliest fiscal period start; with no fiscal period, no date is pre-ledger), Staged entry and Staged line (not entities), Insert-only log records (classification.rule_match, ingestion.staged_entry_audit; not entities; 2026-10-03), Component rows (positions.account_snapshot_line, investment_account_owner, property_owner, property_asset_account, property_mortgage_account; not entities, REQ-SYS-3.1 n/a; 2026-10-05), Postable, Person vs User (never conflated; 2026-10-04), Interface, Actors, Interface/Application/Persistence layer. Note: Definitions' Component rows does NOT list positions.account_snapshot_lot (new 2026-10-10 table). Check the Positions spec before flagging it.
